title: HurtPayload
description: The hurt event the Body reports when it takes damage (wave PX, PX-1). PROVISIONAL vocabulary (decision 0143). Carries no coordinates. Bearing is relative to the Body's facing, not compass.

bearing.description: Where the attacker stood relative to the Body's facing. Absent when the attacker is unknown.

mob.description: The attacking mob type, when the source is a mob.

amount.description: Health lost, rounded and capped at the health left. Zero-amount hurts are not emitted.
